name: Anokha Cubing Royale 2017
information: Registrations close on the 24th of February 23:59 IST. No walk in registrations will be allowed. Steps to Register: 1. Pay fees [here](http://www.cubelelo.com/competitions) after reading the fee structure. 2. Register under the registrations tab here. Registrations will only be accepted after both steps have been followed. There will also be a passport to be collected as part of the college fest, on the day of the event. The cost for the passport is INR 300/- which is independent of the event fee. Please carry your original school/college/other ID proof to collect the passport.
